home.hero.heading: This election, Bengaluru will elect ward councillors under the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) for the first time.
home.hero.subheading: Before you vote, understand your neighbourhood, explore the candidates, see the public infrastructure around you, and learn how your local government shapes everyday life.
home.whyVote.title: Why your vote in the ward election matters.
home.whyVote.paragraph1: Bengaluru has not held local body elections since 2015, leaving neighbourhoods without direct, accountable representation in the system.
home.whyVote.paragraph2: Over these years, the city has continued to spend significant public funds worth Rs 38,455 crore annually; citizens have no clarity on where it has been spent, how spending decisions are made, or whom to hold responsible when services fall short.
home.whyVote.paragraph3: On the ground this shows up as damaged roads, uncleared garbage, overflowing drains, unusable footpaths and unreliable streetlights, without any elected representative who can be held accountable.
home.whyVote.paragraph4: This election is an opportunity to restore that link.
home.whyVote.paragraph5: Voting strengthens democracy and empowers citizens to hold local leaders accountable, allowing every citizen to shape their city. Your vote decides who represents your ward, who raises your concerns, and who holds the system to account. It shapes how your neighbourhood functions and how responsive the city becomes.
home.whyVote.closing: So vote to shape the future of your ward. And your city.
home.basics.title: Three things worth understanding.
home.basics.item1.title: What is the Greater Bengaluru Authority?
home.basics.item1.body: The Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) is the apex civic body for the Bengaluru metropolitan region. It coordinates planning, infrastructure and governance across the city. Under the Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024, the erstwhile Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) has been reconstituted into multiple City Corporations (currently five), which now perform municipal functions within the Greater Bengaluru Area under the overarching coordination and supervision of the Greater Bengaluru Authority and its Executive Committee.
home.basics.item2.title: What is a ward
home.basics.item2.body: A ward is the smallest electoral unit in a city. It is the neighbourhood or group of neighbourhoods you live in. Every ward elects one councillor who works on local civic issues such as roads, parks, sanitation, drainage, streetlights, and neighbourhood infrastructure.
home.basics.item3.title: What is a ward councillor?
home.basics.item3.body: A ward councillor is your elected representative in local government. They represent your neighbourhood, raise local issues, oversee civic works, and help ensure municipal services respond to residents' needs.

transcribe.guide.heading: How to check an affidavit
transcribe.guide.lead: Citizens read these values to decide how to vote. What you save is published immediately, with no second check. Work from the scan, not from what looks likely.
transcribe.guide.steps.heading: For each affidavit
transcribe.guide.steps.1: Press Start. You are given the next affidavit; you cannot choose the ward, party or candidate.
transcribe.guide.steps.2: The scan is on the left and the values the AI read are on the right. Find each value in the scan yourself.
transcribe.guide.steps.3: If the value matches, tick the box. If it is wrong, correct it and tick the box.
transcribe.guide.steps.4: Save. Ticked fields are published as checked by a person. Fields you did not tick keep the AI label.
transcribe.guide.steps.5: You have 45 minutes for each affidavit. After that it goes to someone else and nothing you typed is saved.
transcribe.guide.rules.heading: Three answers, and when to use each
transcribe.guide.rules.value: A value: you can read it in the scan. Write it in English, converting Kannada numerals.
transcribe.guide.rules.notDeclared: Not declared: the section is blank or missing. This is a complete answer. If the affidavit says nil for criminal cases, that is a value of 0 and 0, not Not declared.
transcribe.guide.rules.unreadable: Cannot read: something is written but you cannot make it out. The page will show it as unresolved.
transcribe.guide.never.heading: Never guess
transcribe.guide.never.body: A wrong figure about a candidate's assets or criminal cases is worse than no figure. If you are not sure of a digit, choose Cannot read. Do not tick a field you did not look up in the scan, even when the AI's value looks right.
transcribe.guide.wrong.heading: Wrong ward or wrong document
transcribe.guide.wrong.body: If the affidavit is for a different ward, is not an affidavit, or belongs to another person, do not correct the values. Use the section at the bottom of the screen to send it to an admin with a short note.
transcribe.guide.assets.heading: Assets and cases
transcribe.guide.assets.body: Assets are the totals the affidavit prints for movable and for immovable assets, added across the candidate, spouse, dependents and HUF, without subtracting loans. The screen adds the two for you. For cases, count a case with a conviction only under convictions, even if an appeal is pending.

curator.guide.meta.title: Curator guide
curator.guide.meta.description: What a curator is asked to do and the standard they work to
curator.guide.heading: How to work as a curator
curator.guide.lead: Citizens tell us when something on a candidate's page looks wrong. You check what they say against the candidate's affidavit and either fix the page or explain why it stays as it is.
curator.guide.flags.heading: Answering a flag
curator.guide.flags.1: Open the flag from the Flags list. The affidavit is on the left; the citizen's comment and the published value are on the right.
curator.guide.flags.2: Find the value in the affidavit yourself. A citizen's suggestion or link is a lead, not a source.
curator.guide.flags.3: If the published value is wrong, type what the affidavit says and publish. The page changes within a minute.
curator.guide.flags.4: If the published value matches the affidavit, dismiss the flag and say why.
curator.guide.reason.heading: The reason is read by the person who flagged
curator.guide.reason.body: A dismissal reason appears on that citizen's own page. Write it to them, plainly: what the affidavit says and where. Never write a name, a phone number or a guess about their motives.
curator.guide.never.heading: Never guess
curator.guide.never.body: If you cannot read a value, choose "Could not be read". If the affidavit leaves it blank, choose "Not declared". Both are honest answers. A plausible number is not.
curator.guide.ward.heading: A candidate in the wrong ward
curator.guide.ward.body: A flag on the ward is fixed by moving the candidate to the ward the affidavit names. Their page, their place in the ward's list and any other open flags move with them.
curator.guide.matching.heading: Affidavits waiting for a match
curator.guide.matching.body: Some affidavits could not be published because the ward was unclear, the name matches a candidate already here, or a transcriber sent them back. Compare the name, party and ward the AI read with the PDF, choose the ward, and for a same-name candidate decide whether it is the same person. If you are not sure, leave it waiting: a wrong match overwrites another candidate's page and cannot be undone.
curator.guide.notYours.heading: What is not your job
curator.guide.notYours.body: You do not re-read affidavits nobody flagged, approve transcribers' work, upload affidavits or deal with ones the AI failed to read. If you come across a wrong value while working, you may correct it in the candidate editor.
curator.guide.contact.heading: When to tell the admin
curator.guide.contact.body: A document that is unusable, belongs to somebody who is not standing, or is missing altogether cannot be fixed from here. Leave it as it is and tell the admin which candidate or affidavit number it is.

__hints.curator.candidateEdit.error.affidavitDup: Error on the curator candidate editor when the uploaded affidavit PDF is byte-identical to one already in the system.
__hints.curator.candidateEdit.affidavit.status.p: Status badge beside a stored affidavit on the curator candidate editor: the PDF is queued and the AI has not read it yet.
__hints.admin.console.nav.affidavits: Link on /admin to the page where affidavit PDFs are uploaded and matched to candidates.
__hints.admin.affidavits.counts.heading: Heading above five counters of affidavits by processing state.
__hints.admin.affidavits.state.queued: Counter label: affidavits uploaded but not yet read by the AI.
__hints.admin.affidavits.state.extracting: Counter label: affidavits the AI is reading right now.
__hints.admin.affidavits.state.needs_matching: Counter label: affidavits the AI read but that an admin must tie to a ward and candidate.
__hints.admin.affidavits.state.published: Counter label: affidavits whose values are live on a candidate page.
__hints.admin.affidavits.state.failed: Counter label: affidavits the AI could not read after all attempts.
__hints.admin.affidavits.upload.submit: Button that uploads the chosen affidavit PDFs and queues them for AI reading.
__hints.admin.affidavits.viewPdf: Link to a stored affidavit PDF; {id} is its internal number.
__hints.admin.affidavits.reason.ward_unresolved: Tag on an affidavit: the AI could not tie it to exactly one ward.
__hints.admin.affidavits.reason.possible_duplica: Tag on an affidavit: a candidate of the same name already exists in that ward.
__hints.admin.affidavits.reason.reported_by_tran: Tag on an affidavit: a transcriber reported it as the wrong ward or the wrong document.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.wardNotRead: Shown when the AI read no ward from the affidavit.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.confidence: Label for the AI's own 0-100 confidence figure for an affidavit.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.attach: Label for a dropdown asking whether the affidavit belongs to a candidate already in the system.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.submit: Button: the admin confirms who an affidavit is for, which publishes the candidate.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.submitCorrection: Button: the admin corrects the ward, name or party of an already-published candidate.
__hints.admin.affidavits.failed.retry: Button that puts a failed affidavit back in the queue for the AI.
__hints.admin.affidavits.failed.discard: Button that permanently deletes a failed affidavit and its PDF.
__hints.admin.affidavits.failed.discardConfirm: Confirmation tick beside the Discard button.
__hints.admin.affidavits.notice.uploaded: Result of a bulk affidavit upload; all three placeholders are counts of files.
__hints.admin.affidavits.error.partyRequired: Keep the English word Independent: it is the literal value to type.
__hints.transcribe.layout.wordmark: Header wordmark on the transcriber screens.
__hints.transcribe.layout.guide: Header link to the transcriber guide page.
__hints.transcribe.start.doneToday: Count of affidavits this transcriber has saved today.
__hints.transcribe.start.submit: The single button that hands the transcriber the next affidavit.
__hints.transcribe.start.next: Same button as Start, shown after the transcriber has just saved one.
__hints.transcribe.start.resume: Button returning the transcriber to the affidavit they already hold.
__hints.transcribe.reading.pdfTitle: Accessible title of the frame showing the affidavit PDF.
__hints.transcribe.reading.confidence: Label for the AI's own 0-100 confidence figure for the affidavit.
__hints.transcribe.reading.timeLeft: Label for the countdown until the transcriber's hold on this affidavit expires.
__hints.transcribe.reading.status.legend: Legend of the three-way choice for one field: a value, not declared, or cannot read.
__hints.transcribe.reading.status.value: Choice: the affidavit states a value for this field.
__hints.transcribe.reading.status.not_declared: Choice: the affidavit leaves this field blank or has no such section.
__hints.transcribe.reading.status.unreadable: Choice: the value is there but the transcriber cannot read it from the scan.
__hints.transcribe.reading.tick: Checkbox a transcriber ticks for each field they compared with the scan.
__hints.transcribe.reading.badge.ai: Badge on a field whose published value was read by AI and not yet checked.
__hints.transcribe.reading.badge.checked: Badge on a field whose published value a person has already checked.
__hints.transcribe.reading.aiNote: Prefix for the AI's one-line explanation of how it read assets or cases.
__hints.transcribe.reading.input.party: Keep the English word Independent: it is the literal value to type.
__hints.transcribe.reading.input.educationLevel: Label for a dropdown of education levels such as 10th Pass or Graduate.
__hints.transcribe.reading.assetsTotal: Label for the computed sum of movable and immovable assets.
__hints.transcribe.reading.save: Button that publishes the ticked fields and returns to the start screen.
__hints.transcribe.reading.release: Button that gives the affidavit back to the queue without saving anything.
__hints.transcribe.reading.report.summary: Expandable section for reporting that the affidavit is attached to the wrong ward or is not this candidate's affidavit.
__hints.common.unreadable: Shown on a candidate's page in place of a value that neither the AI nor a person could read from the scanned affidavit. Different from 'Not declared', which means the affidavit left it blank.
__hints.admin.affidavits.match.stillPublished: Shown on an affidavit a transcriber sent back: unlike a new affidavit, its candidate is already public.
__hints.curator.fix.confirm: Label on the REQUIRED confirmation checkbox on a curator's fix form (a flag, or the candidate editor) — {path} is a literal URL path like '/ward/57' and must NOT be translated or altered.
__hints.curator.fix.dismissOnly: Shown in place of the fix form for a flag on something curators no longer take flags on (rows older than the eight-field rule). 'Dismissed' means the Reject button on the same page.
__hints.curator.fix.error.unchanged: Refusal when a curator saves a fix identical to what is published (or the ward the candidate is already in). 'Dismiss' means the Reject button on the same page.
__hints.curator.queueItem.candidateLine: The flagged candidate and their ward on the flag page — {name} is the candidate's English name, {ward} the ward name without its number. Only the separator is fixed text.
__hints.curator.dashboard.matchCount: Count on the curator dashboard's matching card: {count} is a plain integer, the number of affidavits waiting.
__hints.curator.matching.item.heading: H1 on /curator/matching/{id}: {id} is the affidavit's number and must stay as it is.
__hints.curator.matching.item.attachExisting: Option in the 'Same person as' dropdown: {name} is a candidate's English name, {ward} a ward label like 'South 14 · Hebbal'. The dropdown's label already says 'Same person as'.
__hints.curator.matching.item.unusable: Curators cannot retry or discard an affidavit; only the admin can. 'Standing' means standing for election.
